lots.title: Highland Park Viking Honour 12 (GB)
lots.seen_in_photos: Black Viking Honour 12 bottle with embossed Norse design, black capsule with Celtic knot neck band (capsule split at top), front label, back label with Australian and NZ importer stickers, black gift box.
lots.text_read: HIGHLAND PARK 12 YEAR OLD VIKING HONOUR SINGLE MALT SCOTCH WHISKY alc.40% vol 700ml; back: SPICY & WELL-ROUNDED, wild harmony of honey-drenched oranges, winter-spiced fruitcake and floral peat smoke; Distilled and Bottled by Highland Park Distillery Kirkwall Orkney; HPR133; barcode 5010314570101; Standard Drinks 22.1 approx; Imported and Distributed by Spirits Platform Pty Ltd Botany NSW; Hancocks Wine, Spirit & Beer Merchants Mangere Auckland.
lots.not_in_title: Only the NZ/AU importer details (Hancocks) and 700ml, nothing of value.
lots.reason: Current core-range bottling, accurately described. Nothing hidden.
lots.bottling_era: Current, about 2018-2022 (barcode, standard drinks label, current Viking Honour design)
lots.condition: Capsule has a visible split/tear at the top edge (photo 3). Fill in neck, normal.

lots.title: J & A Mitchell Longrow 15 Year Old Open Day (350ml, 59.2%)
lots.seen_in_photos: Clear 35cl bottle with cream and brown Longrow label, black capsule (small tear on left side at base), fill in neck, slightly amber spirit with a yellow ring at the fill.
lots.text_read: Longrow; OPEN DAY - MAY 2026; AGED 5 YEARS; SINGLE MALT SCOTCH WHISKY; Maturation: Bourbon & Chardonnay casks; Contents: 35cl; Strength: 59.2%vol; One of: 1,750 Bottles; Distilled at Springbank Distillery by J & A Mitchell & Co. Ltd; PRODUCT OF SCOTLAND; MATURED IN OAK CASKS.
lots.not_in_title: Actually 5 years old, May 2026 Open Day release, bourbon and Chardonnay casks, edition of 1,750.
lots.title_errors: Title says 15 Year Old; label says AGED 5 YEARS. Title overstates age by 10 years.
lots.reason: Reverse case: the title overstates the age. Limited Open Day bottle (1,750) so some collector interest, but a recent 5 YO, not a 15 YO. Bidders reading the title may overpay; no hidden upside.
lots.condition: Capsule has a small tear at the lower left edge; fill in neck. Spirit looks darker in photo 3 than photo 1 but that is lighting.

lots.title: Kilchoman 10th Anniversary Release 2005-2015
lots.seen_in_photos: Blue capsule printed Islay's Farm Distillery, medallion on shoulder, blue and gold label with signatures, box, back label with hand-written bottle number, base glass code.
lots.text_read: KILCHOMAN Islay's Farm Distillery; ISLAY SINGLE MALT SCOTCH WHISKY; NON CHILL FILTERED & NATURAL COLOUR; 10th ANNIVERSARY RELEASE 2005-2015; 700ml 58.2% vol; DISTILLED, MATURED AND BOTTLED BY KILCHOMAN DISTILLERY; back: BOTTLE NUMBER 1604/3000 (handwritten, last digits fairly clear); tasting notes; UK units 40.1; glass code 10A 15.06.15 15/26.
lots.not_in_title: Individually numbered bottle (appears 1604 of 3000), bottled 15 June 2015 by the glass code; box says LIMITED edition.
lots.reason: Title accurate; limited numbered release is already implied by the title. Minor extra detail only.
lots.condition: Capsule intact, fill into neck, clean.
lots.unreadable: Handwritten number could be 1604 or 1601; box text cut off

lots.title: Knockando Slow Matured 18 (GB)
lots.seen_in_photos: Black and gold Knockando 18 bottle with tube, capsule with K 1898 roundels, shoulder medallion, back label.
lots.text_read: KNOCKANDO SINGLE MALT SCOTCH WHISKY EST. 1898 SPEYSIDE Slow matured AGED 18 YEARS; 70cl 43% vol; NOTES Rich, woody & fruity; Distilled and bottled in Scotland; back in French: DISTILLE ET MIS EN BOUTEILLE EN ECOSSE, Importe par DBBV Molenwerf 12 1014 BG NL, Knockando Distillery est detenue par Justerini & Brooks St James's Street Londres SW1; Knockando Distillery Banffshire AB38 7RT; barcode 5010103802550; 23 x 30ml, 10.5g alcohol, 71 kcal; 310548 0380.
lots.not_in_title: European market bottling (Dutch importer DBBV, French back label), Justerini & Brooks ownership. Slow Matured black label, not a collector item.
lots.reason: Accurately described current 18 YO. Euro market back label adds no value.
lots.bottling_era: Current, about 2018-2022 (J&B owned era, black Slow Matured label)
lots.condition: Capsule shows small vertical crease and tear marks near the top; fill is in the neck about mid-neck (photo 3), which is within normal for a modern bottle but slightly lower than the Jura and Highland Park.
